items.name: design-tokens
items.title: UI-Libary Design Tokens
items.description: Semantic light/dark CSS variables, intentional typography pairings, concentric border radii, and Apple-calibrated motion curves.

items.name: motion-tokens
items.title: Apple-Calibrated Motion Presets
items.description: Shared spring physics (tactile 380/32/0.8, fluid 240/28) and Apple deceleration curve cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for motion/react.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action Button Primitive
items.description: Accessible button primitive with primary/secondary/outline/ghost variants, tactile scale compression (0.97), and loading state.

items.name: surface-card
items.title: Surface Card Primitive
items.description: Composable card primitives (Header, Title, Description, Content, Footer) built with crisp 1px hairline borders and tonal surface tokens.

items.name: tactile-tabs
items.title: Tactile Tabs & Dock
items.description: Tabs and Dock switcher with shared layoutId indicator, tactile spring (380/32/0.8), WAI-ARIA keyboard navigation, AnimatePresence mode='popLayout', and skeleton/empty/error states.

items.name: app-store-card
items.title: App Store Expandable Card
items.description: Expandable detail card with shared layoutId spatial continuity, AnimatePresence mode='popLayout', fluid spring (240/28), drag-to-dismiss gesture, focus restoration, and skeleton/error states.

items.name: sticky-product-showcase
items.title: Sticky Product Showcase
items.description: Scroll-linked Apple-style product narrative using useScroll, useTransform, progressive clip-path aperture, sticky stage parallax, and accessible chapter controls.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Curated 21st.dev radiogroup switcher upgraded with layoutId tactile spring, arrow-key navigation, and semantic surface tokens.

items.name: action-search-bar
items.title: Action Search Bar
items.description: Curated 21st.dev command filter input with ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape keyboard navigation, AnimatePresence mode='popLayout', and empty state.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree Explorer
items.description: Curated 21st.dev repository directory viewer with tactile disclosure chevrons, keyboard focus rings, and token styling.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Hairline Scroll Progress
items.description: GPU-composited scaleX top reading indicator using the single --accent-primary token without multi-color gradients.

items.name: pricing-selector
items.title: Pricing Selector
items.description: Curated 21st.dev plan selector refactored with layoutId billing toggle, spring selection ring, and tabular-nums pricing.

items.name: kpi-metric-card
items.title: KPI Metric Card
items.description: Data-viz summary card with right-aligned tabular-nums metrics, semantic delta indicators, and skeleton/error variants.

items.name: state-notice
items.title: Feedback State Notices
items.description: Composable EmptyState, ErrorNotice, and SkeletonBlock feedback primitives matching real interface layouts.

items.name: hero-editorial
items.title: Hero Editorial Pattern
items.description: Asymmetric 50/50 split hero pairing concrete thesis copy and tabular specs with a live interactive artifact.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard Shell Pattern
items.description: Persistent workspace sidebar with layoutId active indicator, tabular item counts, and structured header/content slots.

items.name: auth-minimal
items.title: Auth Minimal Pattern
items.description: Focused passwordless email sign-in surface with explicit idle, loading, inline validation error, and sent states.
